foldStateJump.clangPath.description: Legacy fallback compiler setting; native AST extraction uses the version of Clang LibTooling linked into fold-state-jump-ast.

foldStateJump.maxAstBytes.description: Safety limit for compact native AST extraction JSON output in bytes (default 64 MiB).

foldStateJump.compileCommandsPath.description: Path to compile_commands.json, absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. When empty, standard project and build directories are searched.

foldStateJump.extractorPath.description: Native LibTooling extractor executable. Empty uses native/build/fold-state-jump-ast within the extension installation. Build it with bun run build:native.

foldStateJump.cache.disk.enabled.description: Persist validated compact AST snapshots across extension reloads.

foldStateJump.cache.disk.maxBytes.description: Soft disk AST cache capacity, independent of the native output safety limit.

foldStateJump.prewarm.enabled.description: Prewarm only the active saved C/C++ file after editor and save events. At most one native extraction runs.

foldStateJump.prewarm.delayMs.description: Debounce delay for background AST preparation.

foldStateJump.prewarm.onSave.description: Schedule active saved files for background AST preparation.
